name: Barbell Seated Good Morning
steps: Sit tall astride a bench with your feet planted wide and flat, resting a barbell securely across your upper back.
Brace your abdomen and steady the bar against your upper back.
Hinge smoothly forward from your hips, folding your torso down between your thighs as far as your back stays flat.
Press your feet into the floor and extend your hips to return to sitting tall.
tips: Keep your chest and pelvis moving together as one rigid unit without rounding your lower back.
Control the depth carefully and use a conservative weight compared with standing good mornings.
